tools.description: Sets the push event settings. Required: serviceSettings, serviceType, status, subscribeToEventTypes. Optional: subscribeToCompanies. Returns the new PushSetResponse.

params.name: serviceSettings
params.description: Specific settings for each service type. For information regarding the service settings, refer to Service Type Settings.

params.name: serviceType

params.name: subscribeToEventTypes

tools.name: push_stats
tools.description: Gets the push event statistics and errors. Returns the new PushStatsResponse.

tools.name: push_test

tools.name: quarantine_add-file

params.name: endpointIds

params.name: filePath

tools.name: quarantine_empty

params.name: service

params.name: includeSubCompanies

tools.name: quarantine_list

params.name: service
params.description: Quarantine service: computers (Computers and Virtual Machines) or exchange (Security for Exchange).

params.name: companyId
params.description: The ID of the company for which the quarantine items are retrieved. Default value: the company the API key used to make the request belongs to.

params.name: endpointId

params.name: page
params.description: The results page. The default value is 1.

tools.name: quarantine_release-exchange
tools.description: Creates a new task to release items from the quarantine to their intended recipients. Required: quarantineItemsIds. Returns the new QuarantineReleaseExchangeResponse.

params.name: quarantineItemsIds
params.description: The list of IDs for the quarantined items. You can restore maximum 100 items once.

tools.name: quarantine_remove
tools.description: Creates a new task to remove items from quarantine. Required: service (default: computers), quarantineItemsIds. Returns the new QuarantineRemoveResponse.

params.name: service
params.description: Quarantine service: computers (Computers and Virtual Machines) or exchange (Security for Exchange).

params.name: quarantineItemsIds
params.description: The list of quarantine items IDs. The maximum number of items that can be removed once is 100. The ID must belong to a quarantine item that the user has permission to access.

tools.name: quarantine_restore

params.name: locationToRestore
params.description: The absolute path to the folder where the items will be restored. If the parameter is not set, the original location will be used.

params.name: quarantineItemsIds
params.description: The list of IDs for the quarantined items. You can restore maximum 100 items once.

params.name: email

params.name: ewsUrl
params.description: The Exchange Web Services URL .The EWS URL is necessary when the Exchange Autodiscovery does not work.

params.name: password
params.description: The password of an Exchange user.

params.name: quarantineItemsIds
params.description: The list of IDs for the quarantined items. You can restore maximum 100 items once.

params.name: username
params.description: The username of an Microsoft Exchange user. The username must include the domain name.

params.name: targetIds

tools.name: reports_download-links
tools.description: Returns an Object with information regarding the report availability for download and the corresponding download links. Required: reportId.

params.name: reportId

tools.name: reports_list
tools.description: Returns the list of scheduled reports, according to the parameters received. Optional: name, page, perPage (plus 1 more).

params.name: page

params.name: perPage

params.name: type
params.description: The report type. tools.name: response_actions_create
tools.description: Take response actions on user nodes generated in GravityZone XDR incidents or your own SOC-generated incidents. You can make the request based on an XDR incident ID, or based on user data specified in the node. Required: actionType. Optional: emailId, fileUrl, incidentId (plus 3 more). Returns the new ResponseActionsCreateResponse.

params.name: actionType
params.description: The type of action to be taken and the type of environment it will be applied to. Possible values: 1 - Reset credentials for a Microsoft 365 (Office 365) or Entra ID (Azure AD) user. 2 - Reset credentials for an Active Directory user.

params.name: emailId
params.description: The email ID associated with the user node. For actionType 11, this is the ID of the reference email used to identify similar emails. When actionType is 11 and incidentId is used, if the incident contains exactly one email resource, emailId defaults to that email’s ID.

params.name: fileUrl

params.name: incidentId

params.name: integrationIdentifiers

params.name: targets

params.name: username

tools.name: response_actions_status

params.name: endpointId

params.name: page
params.description: The results page number. Default page number is 1.

params.name: perPage
params.description: The number of items displayed in a page.

params.name: status

tools.name: tasks_reconfigure
tools.description: Creates a new Reconfigure Agent task. With this task you can choose which modules to install on target agents. Required: targetIds. Optional: modules, productType, roles (plus 2 more). Returns the new TasksReconfigureResponse.

params.name: modules
params.description: The modules to be enabled or disabled. The object contains the following fields: antimalware advancedThreatControl firewall contentControl deviceControl userControl antiphishing trafficScan powerUser encryption edrSensor advancedAntiExploit containerProtection patchManagement networkAttackDefense in...

params.name: productType
params.description: This parameter determines the operation mode of the security agent. params.name: scanMode

params.name: scheduler

params.name: targetId

params.name: taskName

params.name: targetIds

params.name: type

novel_features.name: Fleet health rollup
novel_features.description: One ranked table of every child company's unmanaged, outdated, unscanned, policy-not-applied and isolated endpoints, saved as a dated snapshot.

novel_features.name: Cross-tenant incident queue
novel_features.description: Open EDR/XDR incidents across all child companies, ranked by severity and age with unassigned and SLA-breach flags.

novel_features.name: Partner tree
novel_features.description: Your own company plus every child company and sub-partner under it as one flat list with ids, type, parent and depth.

novel_features.name: Billing table
novel_features.description: Per-company billable usage for a month with own share after the child rollup, month-over-month seat swings, and flags wherever a needed fetch failed.

novel_features.name: RMM coverage gap
novel_features.description: Joins an RMM device export to GravityZone inventory to list devices with no agent, discovered-but-unmanaged machines, and agents the RMM does not know.

novel_features.name: Fleet changes
novel_features.description: What changed between saved fleet health snapshots (needs at least two): new and removed endpoints, newly unmanaged, outdated or isolated machines, policy flips.

novel_features.name: Cross-tenant threat correlation
novel_features.description: The same quarantined file (SHA256) seen at two or more companies in a window, and which of those companies already blocklist it.

novel_features.name: Fleet-wide endpoint locator
novel_features.description: Find a machine by hostname, IP, MAC or label across every child company and get its endpoint id and company.
